falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal a new lower low and structural breakdown rather than a repeat bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28; sustained readings above 35 would indicate panic exceeding that prior regime, contradicting the 'bottom' pattern and suggesting a more severe liquidation phase than the template allows

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid this aggressive would signal recession/deleveraging fears overwhelming the current macro setup; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising, so this would break the pattern's interest rate regime and invalidate the comparison

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
